subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks gain a core current-session reset capability across every OpenClaw, Codex, and bundled Copilot compaction surface?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin hook capability and defines which runtimes may rotate session state; code review can verify mechanics but cannot choose the permanent hook contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, fix all sibling lifecycle paths and notifications, split unrelated behavior, and require positive live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset owner-internal
options.body: Do not add a plugin hook API; implement reset policy only inside the owning context or memory plugin through an existing core-owned lifecycle seam.

options.title: Pause and redesign
options.body: Close or pause this branch until compaction recovery, model locks, notifications, and plugin authority have one documented lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, fix all sibling lifecycle paths and notifications, split unrelated behavior, and require positive live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily concerns compaction-hook semantics and embedded-agent lifecycle ownership, areas most strongly connected to this person's merged history.
